hud_clock_hint: From round {rules.battle.clock_start} every enemy fires with +1 ATK more each round; now +{bonus}.
admiral_select_hint: One flagship against their fleet. Your admiral brings the ship, a passive, an admiral station and two signature cards in the starter deck.

board.heading: Board
paragraphs: Your flagship stands alone in one of three columns. Across from it the enemy fleet holds two rows, front and back, of three columns each, with at most four units.
A unit in the back row is covered while a unit stands in front of it in its column: the front unit takes half of every hit (rounded up), the target the rest.
Enemies fire in two ways. Targeted fire follows your flagship wherever it flies. Column fire is announced for a column and hits whatever stands there during the enemy turn.

round.heading: Round
paragraphs: A round is your turn, the enemy turn and the resolution. Before round 1 you see the formation and its intents and may pick your column with a click on your side.

In your turn every card and your station take effect at once, in the order you choose. Cards cost command points: {rules.battle.command_points} each round, unused points are lost. End turn when you are done; a round without a station is allowed.
In the enemy turn each unit does what it announced, front before back, left to right. Then burns tick, shields expire, your hand is discarded and you draw {rules.battle.hand_size} new cards.
From round {rules.battle.clock_start} the battle clock gives every enemy +1 ATK per round.

stations.heading: Stations
paragraphs: Your flagship triggers one station per round, with Red Alert a second, different one. It is triggered like a card and gets its target the same way: weapons, focus fire and stasis an enemy ship, maneuver another column; the other stations need none. It takes effect at once.

Weapons fire your ATK at the target. Shields absorb {admirals.vance.shield_station} in the next enemy turn (Osei {admirals.osei.shield_station}). Damage control puts out the fire and repairs {rules.stations.damage_control_repair} hull. Maneuver moves to another column and dodges column fire aimed at the old one.
The admiral station depends on your admiral and is not available while your bridge is hit (hull at {rules.battle.emergency_percent} % or less).

damage.heading: Damage
paragraphs: Every shot hits and every number is fixed: what the preview shows is what happens.
From the damage of a shot come off, in this order: evading halves it, armor subtracts, cover passes half to the unit in front, shields absorb the rest until they are spent.
Column fire and ramming hit fully or not at all; evading does not count against them.

conditions.heading: Conditions
paragraphs: Burning: a hit that brings a unit to {rules.battle.burn_percent} % hull or less sets it on fire. A burning unit loses {rules.battle.burn_damage} hull in each resolution; your own fire is put out by damage control or the repair crew.
Emergency: at {rules.battle.emergency_percent} % hull or less a unit fires with half ATK and no longer evades. Your flagship cannot trigger its admiral station.
Destroyed: an enemy at 0 hull falls at once and never acts again. If your flagship falls, the battle is lost.

admirals.heading: Admirals
paragraphs: Osei, the Wall: Bastion, {admirals.osei.hull} hull, {admirals.osei.attack} ATK. Shields absorb {admirals.osei.shield_station}. Counterfire: shields {rules.stations.counterfire_shield}, retaliation {rules.stations.counterfire_damage}.

Vance, the Hammer: Vanguard, {admirals.vance.hull} hull, {admirals.vance.attack} ATK. Momentum: +1 ATK for each round in a row with weapons or focus fire, up to +{rules.stations.max_momentum}. Focus fire: double momentum, homing, but takes {rules.stations.focus_fire_vulnerability} more per hit.
Kerr, the Clockmaker: Pendulum, {admirals.kerr.hull} hull, {admirals.kerr.attack} ATK. The railgun is homing and piercing; he sees intents two rounds ahead. Stasis: one enemy does not act this round.

Reyes, the Ember: Pyre, {admirals.reyes.hull} hull, {admirals.reyes.attack} ATK. The plasma thrower sets every target on fire, enemy burns tick {rules.battle.ember_burn_damage}. Follow-up: every burning enemy takes double burn damage at once, attack cards on burning targets +{rules.stations.follow_up_card_bonus}.

cards.heading: Cards
paragraphs: Every round you draw {rules.battle.hand_size} commands. Attack cards hit with fixed damage and the usual deductions; buffs strengthen your flagship, debuffs weaken an enemy, tactics change the board. Doctrines stay in play until the battle ends.
Each admiral starts with ten cards: three torpedoes, three emergency shields, a repair crew, scavenge and two signature cards. Upgraded cards (+) deal or absorb 2 more or cost 1 less.

Keywords: Homing – evading does not count. Piercing – cover does not count. Shields N – absorbs N damage in the next enemy turn. Armor N – every hit deals N less. Retaliation N – every shooter that hits your flagship loses N hull. Burning – a burning unit loses {rules.battle.burn_damage} hull in each resolution.

enemies.heading: Enemies and intents
paragraphs: Each enemy follows a fixed pattern and shows what it will do next: targeted fire with its damage, column fire with column and damage, shields, evading, charging, target lock or calling reinforcements.

You act first: an enemy that falls in your turn never carries out its intent, one in emergency acts with half ATK. A micro jump makes every shot miss, a maneuver only the column fire on the old column.
Fighters evade and screen, cruisers are the backbone, battleships charge their main guns and carry armor.

controls.heading: Controls
paragraphs: Click a card to play it; a card with a target waits for a click on a glowing enemy or column. Clicking the card again, right-clicking or Escape cancels.

Stations work the same way: click a station in the panel; without a target it takes effect at once, otherwise the valid targets glow and a click on one triggers it. Hover a glowing enemy to see the damage of the selected card or station.
Space skips the playback, V switches the view, ← → orbit, ↑ ↓ zoom, F toggles fullscreen, Escape opens the settings.

battle_start: All ships at battle stations. Awaiting your orders, Admiral.
Fleet in position. Ready when you are, Admiral.
victory: Enemy fleet destroyed. The sector is ours, Admiral!
That's the last of them. Victory, Admiral!
defeat: We've lost the fleet. All hands, abandon ship.
Our fleet is gone. All survivors, fall back.
column_fire_incoming: Beam weapons charging on our line!
They've got our column bracketed! Get us out of there!
fire_onboard: Fire on deck four! Damage control, move!
We've got fire in the main corridor!
fire_out: Fire's out. Venting the smoke now.
maneuver: Helm, hard to port! Changing lanes!
micro_jump: Spinning up the drive. Jump in three, two, one!
jump_return: Jump complete. We're back in the fight.
Back on the grid. Weapons hot.
ram_incoming: That one's gonna ram us! Brace for impact!
reinforcements_sighted: New contacts! Enemy reinforcements jumping in!
More of them, Admiral. Fresh hostiles on the board.
emergency_generator: Main power's gone! Emergency generator is holding us!
Backup power online! We're still breathing!
repairs: Repair crews on the hull breach.
Damage control teams, patch her up!
direct_hit: Good hit, good hit! Hull breach on target!
enemy_burning: She's on fire! Keep it up!
counterfire: They hit us, we hit back!
enemy_panic: Mayday, mayday! We're breaking up out here!
enemy_charging: Main battery charging. Hold your fire.
Full power to the big gun. On my mark.
enemy_calls_reinforcements: All ships, all ships, converge on my position!
We need backup! Send everything you've got!
enemy_breaking: Break off! Break off! Everyone run!
We can't hold them! Pull back!

menu_tagline: A wormhole swallowed your flagship. Three sectors lie between you and home.
menu_no_runs: No admiral is under way yet. “New run” commissions the first flagship.
map_hint: Choose the next node. The sector's boss waits at the top.

node_kind_hint.battle: A formation of this sector. Loot: scrap and a command card.
node_kind_hint.elite: A mighty battleship. Loot: lots of scrap and a module.
node_kind_hint.event: A scene over the radio with a decision.
node_kind_hint.shipyard: Repair, upgrade a card or remove one.
node_kind_hint.market: Cards, modules, repairs and removals for scrap.
node_kind_hint.boss: The end of the sector. Loot: a module and repairs.

loot_cards_hint: One command card joins the deck, or none.
loot_modules_hint: A module works until the end of the run.

resolute.title: The Wreck of the Resolute
resolute.text: A cruiser of your own fleet drifts burnt out in the field: the Resolute. The wormhole swallowed her too. Her reactor still glows, her beacon repeats the last report in a loop.

pilot.title: The Pilot
pilot.text: A trader hails you on an open channel. A minefield lies ahead, and he knows the safe way through, for a price.

flicker.title: Flicker
flicker.text: The wormhole stirs. For a moment space flickers around the flagship, and in the static lies something familiar.

salvage.label: Salvage
salvage.consequence: +{rules.run.resolute_scrap} scrap; the next battle starts burning.
salvage.outcome: The salvage crews cut out whatever they can carry. As you cast off, a leak in the hangar ignites.

logbooks.label: Secure the logbooks
logbooks.outcome: The logbooks hold blueprints the Resolute no longer needs.

move_on.label: Move on and bury the crew
move_on.outcome: The crew gets their burial in space. Over the radio, the Resolute's last report: "We hold the line."

pay_pilot.label: Pay the pilot
pay_pilot.consequence: {rules.run.pilot_price} scrap; the next node becomes a shipyard.
pay_pilot.outcome: The trader sends his route. A dock waits at its end.

fly_yourself.label: Fly yourself
fly_yourself.outcome: Two mines graze the hull. Containers of command sets drift in the field.

embrace.label: Fly into the flicker
embrace.consequence: −{flicker_damage} hull; a random card is upgraded.
embrace.outcome: The flicker burns through the systems and leaves something behind.

listen.label: Listen
listen.outcome: For the first time since the jump: the radio from home. Then static again.

shipyard_hint: One job, then you move on.
shipyard_upgrade_text: One card of the deck grows stronger.
gallery_upgrade_hint: Choose a card that is not upgraded yet.
gallery_remove_hint: Choose the card that leaves the deck.
market_hint: Paid in scrap. No questions asked.
run_won_text: Commander Vey has fallen, the wormhole stands open. On the other side: your own fleet.
run_lost_text: The flagship fell in sector {sector}, row {row}.
run_abandon_text: The save will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
